name: pii-router
description: Set up, check and tune PII Router, the local proxy that filters personal data out of Codex requests to GPT and Ollama Cloud.

interface.shortDescription: Keep personal data on your Mac
interface.longDescription: Personal data in Codex requests is replaced by [PII:TYPE_n] tags before it reaches a cloud model and restored in the answers. This plugin teaches Codex to work with the tags and to set up, test and tune the filter with the pii-router command.
defaultPrompt: Is my Codex traffic filtered by PII Router?
